title: Full watch snapshot over a local Unix socket

effect.user: A new watcher receives the complete initial state promptly.
assertions: Complete JSON frame, exact row counts and body content, same snapshot sequence across receiver modes.
exclusions: Live database composition and Apiary rendering

repeated.why: Complete 20 MB responses measured after hello.

scale.why: Complete 20 MB responses measured after hello.

fixture.seed: 1000 stopped bees, 900 archived; one 19000-byte seal per bee, generated locally; isolated daemon home/store/socket

recipe.readiness: Handshake complete; clock starts when watch request is written.
recipe.completion: Last newline received; parse measured separately.
recipe.warmup: One request per receiver, then five per receiver interleaved.
recipe.teardown: Stop only owned daemon PID; retain disposable fixture and evidence.

metrics.scope: Client request write to final response byte, including snapshot construction/encode
metrics.collector: monotonic client clock and raw socket data callbacks

budget.condition: 20 MB snapshot on Studio; other hosts give recipe evidence

metrics.invariant: All complete frames preserve exact snapshot content and sequence.
metrics.noise: Shared host timing is recipe evidence; no production baseline.

gaps: Real production size breakdown forbidden by task isolation; generated composition is not a claim about live data.
Studio timing requires running the identical disposable recipe there.
readiness: Executable generated-data recipe proves linear transfer and content parity; shared-host timings are not a retained Studio baseline. Field daemon slowness claim was retracted as probe overhead.
